question: Would applying the mutation signature discount (m_mut) improve held-out hit@20?
structural_finding: has_driver_alteration = mut_driver | fusion_driver is purely boolean and never reads p_mutation. p_mutation feeds only has_alteration (p>0.5), the REJECTED any-alteration gate. The discount therefore cannot move the production arm; only hr_any is affected.
verdict: NO EFFECT -- CI includes 0. The discount does not change held-out hit@20 for the any-alteration arm, and cannot affect the production driver-gated arm at all. Do not wire it in on these grounds.
